values.summary: Prepare #5007 as a proof-gated ADR acceptance handoff: current main integrated, all six cards and design/diagram completed, one bounded GPT-5.5 preparation review retained, and execution left blocked on actual #4760 Memory Palace proof.

steps.action: Integrate current origin/main 51bc5ae51b57c19dbab693af1c5a45142995f4e5 into the existing #5007 preparation branch and verify the worktree path/branch.

Repair all six cards, design, and diagram to the issue-specific proof-gated ADR acceptance plan with exact dependencies, intended paths, COTS, budgets, PVF lanes, rollback, and no-deferral boundaries.
Run one bounded GPT-5.5 preparation review over the preparation packet and fix actionable preparation findings.
Run focused preparation validation and record stale claim/closeout reconciliation as an execution-time gate, not a preparation blocker.

invariants: Preparation never writes the accepted ADR candidate or claims Memory Palace architecture acceptance.
Every later ADR claim must map to retained implementation proof from #4760 plus relevant Chronosense/ObsMem/runtime evidence.
Stale claim reconciliation and typed closeout receipts remain execution-time lifecycle work, not preparation blockers.
No `/private/tmp` use; all build/scratch/validation output stays in the worktree or `/Volumes/FastWork`.
Future execution must recheck `origin/main`, claim ownership, and dependency proof at its exact head.
risks: #4760 may remain open or may close without proof strong enough for ADR acceptance.
Closed dependency issues #4765/#4768/#4771 may not by themselves prove the exact Memory Palace boundary #5007 needs.
ADR numbering may advance before execution; if so, the intended candidate path must be renumbered before drafting.
The current preparation claim is stale; execution must acquire a fresh typed claim before mutation.
stop_conditions: #4760 lacks actual completed implementation proof when execution is requested.
Execution would require drafting the ADR during this preparation-only pass.
Any command attempts to write on `main` or under `/private/tmp`.
Future execution cannot acquire a fresh non-stale issue claim.
A review finding shows the preparation packet overclaims proof or hides a deferral.
replan_triggers: #4760 closes with proof that changes intended ADR scope, paths, or source evidence.
A new ADR number is allocated before #5007 execution.
WP-21 or v0.92 handoff docs change the Memory Palace/ObsMem/Chronosense ownership boundary.
Execution would exceed the declared docs-only COTS or LoC/time budgets.
